client: Hi Luna, I’ve been feeling really overwhelmed lately. Sometimes I wonder if I can really handle all of this, and I’m not sure if talking about it in therapy will even help.
therapist:
Hi there! It sounds like you’re carrying a heavy load right now, with the demands of your graduate program and your job weighing on you. Feeling overwhelmed is completely understandable given the intensity of your responsibilities. 

I hear that you’re questioning whether discussing these feelings in therapy will be beneficial. It’s really common to have doubts, especially when things feel so chaotic. It might help to explore what specifically feels most overwhelming for you right now. 

Sometimes, just expressing what’s on your mind can lighten that burden, even if just a little. You’re doing a lot, and it’s okay to feel uncertain about handling it all. Let’s talk about what you’re experiencing and see if we can find some clarity together.
